notes: EvidencePanel supplies existing inspector geometry, but it is feature-owned and is not duplicated as a generic production component here.
React parity uses a test-local shell harness with synthetic detail content and no Evidence attach or suggestion UI.

geometry.narrow: right drawer no wider than min(100vw, 440px)
geometry.resize: vertical separator adjusts in 16px keyboard steps

expectedTokenGeometry: Inspector is adjacent on desktop and right-aligned on narrow screens
Header remains separated from the scrolling body

r10.keyboardTouch: close is a button; desktop separator handles ArrowLeft and ArrowRight
r10.focus: close control is focusable without trapping desktop focus
r10.screenReader: desktop uses named complementary; narrow mode uses named modal dialog
r10.reducedMotion: layout substitution does not depend on motion
r10.validationBusyDisabledStatus: not applicable to generic inspector chrome
r10.zoom: header and body remain distinct regions
r10.darkLight: harness renders in zai-dark and zai-light wrappers
r10.narrow: modal drawer substitutes below the contracted breakpoint
